Background
 • During the November TAC meeting, Qi noted
 discrepant SGP SEM values compared to previous
 years.
 • Though part of the normal Georgia analyses, SGP
 SEM results are not a part of normal QC as they
 are, in general, not used by Georgia.
 • Upon review of the results and source code in the
 SGP package, it was discovered that the SGP SEMs
 were incorrectly calculated and were too small.

4/30/19 SGP SEM for 2018 EOG/EOC Testing 2

SGP SEM Calculation
 • SGP SEMs are calculation using CSEMs provided
 as part of the state’s assessment data used for SGP
 calculation.
 • Modifications were made to the SGP package in
 2017 to accommodate states supplying error
 variances instead of standard errors.
 • Those changes led to the package simulating SGP
 SEMs using CSEMs approximately half as large as
 actual CSEMs.
 • Recall the results from the November, 2018 TAC.
